title: [TEST SYNTHETIC] Face XYZ loads on Z — titanium shear reference
creator: Xue, Jun
description: Generated synthetic fixture for platform testing. The positive Z face has separate X, Y and Z total force entries of 405 N at step 1 to preview all three boundary directions. Each entry retains frequency 0.5 Hz, duration 4 s and R = -1 as loading metadata. The opposite Z = 0 face is clamped. The supplied curves retain the original homogeneous cyclic X-on-Z simple shear reference with linear kinematic hardening; they are not a calculated response to the combined XYZ loads. No finite element model was solved. All material parameters and orientations are illustrative assumptions.
rights: Generated synthetic fixture for local platform testing
processor_specifications: x86_64; Python analytical calculation, no finite element solver

constitutive_model.plastic_model_name: Linear kinematic hardening restricted to simple shear

plastic_parameters.scope: One shear component only; no general multiaxial plasticity algorithm

texture_extra_information.convention: Bunge Euler angles in radians; active rotation from the laboratory frame
texture_extra_information.role: Synthetic metadata only; no grain geometry or anisotropic solver is used

synthetic_recipe.purpose: Upload, search, boundary viewer, mechanical plots and exact export testing
synthetic_recipe.content_origin: All material, geometry, orientation, load and curve values are generated for this fixture
synthetic_recipe.format_reference: ../a46fde6c.json; field names and structural layout only
assumptions: Illustrative material parameters; not fitted properties of a measured alloy
Small strain with symmetric stress and tensor shear: epsilon_ij = gamma_ij / 2
Temperature is initial metadata; elastic and plastic parameters are held constant
Grain orientations and structured grid describe synthetic metadata; no voxel partition or mesh solution is stored
synthetic_recipe.curve_role: Original homogeneous cyclic X-on-Z simple shear reference only; no response to combined XYZ preview loads or spatial stress/displacement field was solved
synthetic_recipe.force_convention: Each X, Y or Z boundary entry specifies a 405 N total force amplitude over the entire face; none is a force per vertex or per arrow. The stored total_force_N history belongs only to the original X shear reference
synthetic_recipe.shear_convention: Original curve reference: X traction on a Z-normal face gives tau_xz = tau_zx, recorded as stress_13; gamma_xz = 2 * strain_13
equations: If outside yield: delta_gamma_p = sign(tau - alpha_old) * (abs(tau - alpha_old) - 120) / 15000
Accumulated equivalent plastic strain increments by abs(delta_gamma_p)/sqrt(3)
synthetic_recipe.initial_state: Zero stress, strain, plastic shear and backstress
synthetic_recipe.support: The opposite Z = 0 face is clamped; balancing tractions and boundary effects are not resolved by this homogeneous reference
synthetic_recipe.history_interpretation: Explicitly generated two-cycle history, including residual plastic strain; no history is inferred from frequency or duration by the platform
